title: The waiting page file stays under the 16 MB cap as each republish adds rows
why: Measured 17:41 CST Nov 14 (triage fork, from the 17:38 CST build in the scratchpad: live2.json and page2.html): the page is 14,131,165 bytes at version 117 (14.0 MB at version 116; +0.13 MB in one republish) against a 16 MB cap. By part: designData 9.06 MB (64%; 74 designs as HTML strings, the largest 350 KB; these change only when a design is added); the roadmap block 4.66 MB (33%): steps 3.47 MB (2063 steps; note 1.85 MB, why 0.75 MB, ask 0.22 MB, title 0.17 MB) plus the live rows 1.10 MB (557 pulls 130 KB, 2167 sessions 499 KB, 831 items 127 KB, 2012 landedPulls 227 KB in the live file); the rest 0.3 MB. Growth per republish comes from the block (steps notes and why text grow with each filing), not designData. The cap and the 15 MB mark: unmeasured where the page fails at 16 MB (the cap is the artifact limit, not read here). Proposed cuts (not applied, none read by the owner as far as triage knows; unmeasured what he reads): (a) done steps leave the block (740 done, 2 done-obsolete, 42 folded, 3 dropped; the record on the roadmap branch keeps them); (b) landed rows older than 14 days; (c) closed items out of the block; (d) designData entries for closed items (74 designs; he viewed them; the page is their only copy unless the design files live elsewhere: unread). Cuts (a) to (c) lose nothing he reads on the Status tab only if the tab does not list done steps: unread. First act of a lane: read what the Status tab draws from done steps and landed rows, then red then green: the build refuses a block that takes the page past 15 MB (with a line naming the biggest part). Ask the owner only about a cut that removes something he reads (d is the candidate). OWNER 00:15 CST Nov 15 (typed, ruling own-archive-off-page): saved data no longer needed on the page can go to an archive on the roadmap branch and not be loaded to the page. This covers cut (c) and (d) once archived. What already exists, read 00:15 CST Nov 15 on the roadmap checkout: the folder waiting/ (decision waiting-data-in-repo) holds items 744 files (3,124 KB), answers 262 (1,068 KB), groups 14, asks 61, meta 1, page/designData.json 9,065,800 bytes and page/page.html 11,581,546 bytes (both dated Nov 12 04:48); the newest export commit touching waiting/ is d19cf9794 (Nov 13 20:12 UTC). Missing: receipts (0 files; the page database holds 442 receipt documents, 36,989 bytes) and a current copy: the database read 00:15 CST holds 807 closed items alone (2,144,909 bytes) against 744 item files exported, so the export lags and designs added after Nov 12 04:48 are not in designData.json (unmeasured how many). The page file is not the database: closed items are 2.14 MB of it; the 9.06 MB designData is the largest part and has a copy in git only as of Nov 12 (unread whether newer designs differ). Builder: the page writer (triage), by skills/waiting-page/export_page.py, pushed to the roadmap branch with no PR (decision waiting-data-in-repo); the page build change (stop loading archived rows) is a lane. Order: (1) export receipts and a fresh full copy, commit, push, read back; (2) verify each read-back count equals the database count for that kind; (3) only then remove archived rows from the page database and from the page's designData; (4) republish and check size against 15 MB. Never remove before 1 to 2 pass. First act: add receipts to the export and run it (red first: a test that the export holds every receipt and every closed item).
